messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor handshake: short preflight & CTO/VP pocket slot request

Hi team,

Quick ask — InfraEdge (Sanjay Patel) has agreed to a product demo but wants a compact exec presence: CTO + VP if possible for a 30-min window. They prefer late afternoons PT, but are flexible.

Goal: lock a 30-min pocket slot next week (June 9–11) so we can run a 12–15 minute demo, 10-minute Q&A, and a 5-minute next-steps/MAM walk. We'll offer a 15-min prebrief the day before for any execs who want context.

Can you please:
- Ben: reach out to Sanjay with three candidate slots (one late afternoon) and include the brief agenda/MCIs.
- Lauren: prep the condensed demo deck and the prebrief doc (15m) I attached.

Attachments: MAM_InfraEdge_v1.pdf, Agenda_15min_prebrief.docx

If CTO/VP availability looks tight, we’ll propose Evelyn as the senior proxy to handle strategic questions.

Thanks — speedy please, Sanjay mentioned timezones are tight on their side.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@infraedge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor handshake: short preflight & CTO/VP pocket slot request

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the pickup.

We can certainly keep this tight. Proposed 30-min options (PT):
- Wed, Jun 9 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu, Jun 10 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri, Jun 11 — 16:00–16:30 PT

If none fit, we can do Thu Jun 10 at 17:00 PT as a backup; that will be our last-evening slot.

Agenda (12–15m demo):
1) Quick exec intros (2m)
2) Product value + 2 targeted use-cases (6m)
3) Live demo highlight (4m)
4) Q&A + action items (8m)

Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

Question for you: who from InfraEdge will join besides the CTO? If procurement or legal wants to observe, we can include a short run-of-show for them.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@infraedge.com>

Cc: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@infraedge.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor handshake: short preflight & CTO/VP pocket slot request

Thanks Ben — appreciate the options.

Thu, Jun 10 at 17:00 PT works best for our CTO (he's coming out of another set). Please lock that slot. I'll have Maya (VP Product Operations) sit in and loop procurement if we need to follow-up on licensing.

One ask: can you record the session and share the short deck after? Also want the 15-min prebrief the day before for the CTO — Thu Jun 9 at 11:00 PT would be ideal if you have that.

Thanks,
Sanjay
